item.title: Celebrating a successful deployment and future thoughts
item.description:
Cheers! This website got deployed to GitHub today on July 29, 2026.

The main purpose of this website is to host my resume and my contact information. I was on a call yesterday and my friend asked why I didn’t just embed a resume so that it could be downloaded, but I think it looks cleaner this way. Maybe I’ll implement a link or a page sometime for downloadables.

I also wanted to have a place to dump some thoughts, kind of like a substack. I created a private photography instagram account which I treat as a digital diary of sorts, but since this is public the words you see will be slightly filtered. I also don’t plan on posting daily.

item.title: About
item.description:
Kenichi Gomi graduated cum laude from Northeastern University in 2026 with a Bachelor’s of Science in Data Science and Environmental Sustainability Sciences. He has completed two co-ops at Montai Therapeutics and BW Solar as a Data Research Co-op and a Renewable Energy Site Acquisition Co-op respectively. He has a strong passion to analyze energy and environmental data to solve problems.

He is also an avid runner and cyclist. His primary events in track and field include the 800m dash and the mile, but also enjoys the occasional half marathon. Kenichi enjoys bikepacking and camping. In 2025, he and his friends rode up from Boston MA to Burlington VT.
